Read feeding station export files

Source: R/read_station.R
read_station.Rd

Read one or more CSV exports from NEDAP or FIRE feeding stations and combine them into one table.

Usage

read_station(
  files,
  station = NULL,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  fill = FALSE,
  verbose = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

files

Character vector of file paths, or a single folder. For a folder, all files matching pattern are read.

station

"nedap", "fire" or NULL (default) to detect the station type from the column names.

pattern

Regular expression for file names when files is a folder. Default "\\.csv$" (case-insensitive).

fill

If FALSE (default), all files must have the same columns. If TRUE, missing columns are filled with NA.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details per file).

...

Further arguments passed to data.table::fread().

Value

A data.table with the original columns plus source_file (file name without folder). Its attribute "station" holds the station type.

Details

Required columns:

  • NEDAP: responder, location, visit_time, duration, weight, feed_intake.

  • FIRE: Location, Tag, Date, Entry, Exit, Ent Wt, Ext Wt, Consumed, Weight.

Transponder and animal ID columns (responder, animal_number, lifenumber, Tag) are read as character.

Examples

# Write the example data to two CSV files, then read them back
folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "fire_export")
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
data.table::fwrite(fire[fire$Location == 101, ], file.path(folder, "fire_101.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(fire[fire$Location == 102, ], file.path(folder, "fire_102.csv"))

raw <- read_station(folder)
#> 
#> ── Reading 2 files ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ℹ Detected station type "fire"
#> ✔ Read 9794 rows from 2 files (FIRE)
table(raw$source_file)
#> 
#> fire_101.csv fire_102.csv 
#>         6014         3780 
attr(raw, "station")
#> [1] "fire"

unlink(folder, recursive = TRUE)
